tweets.title: Bitcoin was released without a company, patent, or fundraising round. The idea itself was enough.
Bitcoin is the only system where an AI machine can participate without pretending to be human.
Number of @CasaHODL clients who lost bitcoin while having a compromised COLDCARD in their multisig key set: 0.
Millions of people are using Bitcoin together without agreeing on what it will ultimately become.
The smallest Bitcoin node running in a college dorm room can check and reject the work of the largest corporate Bitcoin mining company.

Everyone participating in Bitcoin remains free to leave, reject a software update, copy the code, or use a different version. The network continues because people repeatedly value the same shared history, not because they are trapped inside it.

On this day in history, 15 years ago, the first bitcoin exchange company published their trading data. Internet form users calculated that the price of bitcoin reaching $9 required $800,000 of selling, while reaching $13 required $300,000 of buying.
The most important use of Bitcoin may answer a question humanity has not learned to ask yet.
At first, people called the internet “just a way to send messages”. We are making the same mistake by calling bitcoin “just a way to send money”.

A person born a hundred years from now will be able to start with Bitcoin’s first block and verify every transaction that led to their present. We are the first generation to leave the future a history of the past they can double check for themselves.
